research.primaryInsight: A puppy exposes the house's lack of internal consistency rather than its obedience.
research.counterintuitiveAngle: We thought getting a puppy was about training the dog, but it actually exposed which human has the least discipline in the house.
research.concreteFactOrStory: Leo chewed two pairs of sneakers in 48 hours and figured out who gives unauthorized treats in under two minutes.

hook.text: Most people think getting a puppy brings a family closer together. But in reality, a dog is only as well trained as the least disciplined person in the house.

beats.text: We had no idea what we were doing.
beats.impliedQuestion: What went wrong with the puppy?

beats.text: From day one, Leo figured out that every person had a completely different set of rules.
beats.impliedQuestion: How did Leo react to different rules?

beats.text: He chewed sneakers, ignored commands, and played us against each other.

landing.text: So thank you Leo. You were the best dog—we were just chaotic roommates.
